build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay), per carousel-tile-generation.md standing default. Backgrounds generated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image; this machine has no working Python interpreter, per prior posts' notes) — feed at 3:4/2K, story at 9:16/2K: close-up of a man's hands holding a smartphone inside a modern barbershop, screen rendered as a soft blank warm-gold glow (no fake UI), duotone black-and-white with gold key-light, barber chair and bulb lighting softly blurred in the background. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html / index-story-02.html): a display-size headline in Lost in South, a Fira Sans Condensed gold subtitle, a real product screenshot, a benefit list in Fira Sans Condensed (all digits/labels — never the marker font, per its missing-glyph bug), and a bordered CTA bar. Deliberately kept to a single tile + 2-frame story (no feed carousel) per explicit request that the art not read as text-heavy — the longer explanation lives only in instagram_caption below. CTA is 'link en la bio' per client's confirmed choice, not a literal URL in the art. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). Distinct from the earlier hyperframes video projects on the same topic (posts/instagram/sistema-citas-story/, posts/instagram/como-agendar-citas/, both July 2026) — this is a separate static announcement, not a replacement for those. Revision (same day): client reviewed v1 (small gold pill for 'Nuevo sistema de citas') and asked that it read 'en grande también, así como tu cita ahora en segundos' — replaced the pill with a Lost in South display eyebrow (54px, gold, two lines) plus a short gold-deep hairline underneath, matching the headline's scale and register while keeping SEGUNDOS as the only in-line highlight word so the two blocks don't compete. This also filled the dead-space upper half of the v1 feed tile. Revision 2 (2026-09-11): client asked to drop the speed promise 'Tu cita ahora en segundos' entirely and reframe the message around the fact that the system itself changed — new headline 'AGENDAR AHORA / ES MÁS FÁCIL' (highlight: 'MÁS FÁCIL'), and the 3-row benefit list rewritten to 01 Cambiamos de sistema / 02 Nueva versión / 03 Seguimos mejorando (dropped the old horarios-en-tiempo-real / confirmás-y-listo / recordatorio-automático claims, which the client didn't ask to keep). Eyebrow, CTA, and both background photos (assets/bg.png, assets/bg-story.png) are unchanged — text-only revision, no new image generation. Revision 3 (2026-09-11): client asked (a) to lighten the background photo, (b) to add a real screenshot of the new booking system, (c) to make the main headline 'Agendar ahora es más fácil' large and prominent, and (d) to demote 'Nuevo sistema de citas' to a subtitle with the benefit list shown larger. Inverted the v2 hierarchy: the Lost in South headline now leads at display size (feed 84px, story 108px) instead of sharing marker-font billing with the eyebrow — this also brings the piece back in line with design-system.md §4's one-marker-phrase-per-piece rule, since v2 had two Lost in South blocks. 'Nuevo sistema de citas' moved below the headline as a Fira Sans Condensed ExtraBold gold subtitle (no longer marker font). Added the client-provided screenshot (assets/app-sistema.png, provided directly — not generated) of the booking flow's step 1 ('Seleccione servicio y artista'), shown in a bordered ink card; its own UI is already ink+gold brand colors so it needed no color treatment, and it sits on an opaque ink card so the duotone-photography rule (design-system.md §6) doesn't apply to it. Benefit list dropped its sub-line on the feed tile only (label size raised 29px->34px instead) because the headline + subtitle + screenshot now claim most of the 4:5 canvas's vertical space — full labels *and* sub-lines together no longer fit at a meaningfully larger size; the complete explanation remains in instagram_caption. Background lightened via CSS (brightness(1.9) contrast(1.08) saturate(1.1) on the , scrim-top opacity reduced .55->.3) rather than regenerating — assets/bg.png and assets/bg-story.png are the same source files as v1/v2. The story was split into 2 frames because the same feed hierarchy (big headline + subtitle + screenshot + full benefit list) no longer fits one 9:16 frame at the larger sizes the client asked for: 00-story.png (headline, subtitle, screenshot, CTA) is the hook frame; new 01-story.png (an abbreviated Lost-in-South recap of the headline + the full benefit list with sub-lines, since 9:16 has the room the 4:5 tile didn't + CTA) is the follow-up frame, both built from a shared new index-story-02.html. Note: the screenshot shows real service prices (90.00 Q / 150.00 Q / 130.00 Q) left un-redacted since it's an authentic product screenshot; flag to client before publishing in case they'd rather crop or blur that row.
